vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Lead a parts-planning team and maintain evidence-based replenishment proposals.
requirements.zh: 领导备件计划团队，并维护有依据的补货建议。

requirements.en: Distinguish available stock, held parts and unreceived orders in planning reports.
requirements.zh: 在计划报告中区分可用库存、暂留零件及未收货订单。

requirements.en: Analyze coverage by part and service location without conflating stock risk with equipment failure.
requirements.zh: 按零件及服务地点分析覆盖情况，不混淆库存风险与设备故障。

requirements.en: Coordinate supplier constraints and preserve technical and purchasing approval boundaries.
requirements.zh: 协调供应商限制，并遵守技术及采购审批权限边界。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently approve replacement-part technical equivalence.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立批准替换零件的技术等同性。
